# Sample data: the fictional *Alpenrand* banking group

<!-- Generated by `python -m dora_roi.docs`; do not edit by hand. -->

`roi sample alpenrand.xlsx` (or `roi template --sample`) generates a synthetic but realistic register for a mid-size Swiss/EU banking group. **All organisations are fictional** and LEIs are checksum-valid synthetic values that do not belong to registered entities. Generation is deterministic (default seed 2554); `--clean` omits the injected errors.

Group structure: **Alpenrand Holding AG** (CH, ultimate parent, outside the DORA scope) → **Alpenrand Bank (Europe) AG** (DE); **Alpenrand Banque Privée S.A.** (LU); **Alpenrand Asset Management GmbH** (AT). The German entity maintains the register on a sub-consolidated basis.

| Template | Rows (clean) |
|---|---:|
| B_01.01 | 1 |
| B_01.02 | 3 |
| B_01.03 | 2 |
| B_02.01 | 118 |
| B_02.02 | 150 |
| B_02.03 | 0 |
| B_03.01 | 118 |
| B_03.02 | 118 |
| B_03.03 | 0 |
| B_04.01 | 141 |
| B_05.01 | 45 |
| B_05.02 | 166 |
| B_06.01 | 31 |
| B_07.01 | 107 |

45 ICT third-party providers including three fictional hyperscaler groups (Nimbus, Stratus, Cirrus – US parents with EU operating subsidiaries), an intra-group Swiss shared-service centre, core banking, payments, KYC, wealth, telecom, data-centre and security providers. Subcontracting chains reach rank 3.

## Sample Art. 30 contract assessments

## Sample incidents

5 incidents (`roi sample … --incidents i.json`, loaded automatically by the workbench samples). The open major incident is created a few hours before *now* so that the reporting countdown runs in a demo; below it is shown as of 2026-01-15 12:00 UTC.

| Incident | Title | Classification | Criteria met |
|---|---|---|---|
| `INC-2026-014` | Nimbus EMEA region outage – core banking and payments unavailable | major | clients, reputation, duration, geography, economic |
| `INC-2025-012` | SEPA instant payments rejected – Kronos gateway certificate expired | not_major | — |
| `INC-2025-011` | Regulatory reporting batch delayed (RegFlow) | not_major | — |
| `INC-2025-009` | Phishing campaign against staff mailboxes – contained | not_major | — |
| `INC-2025-006` | SEPA instant payments rejected – Kronos gateway certificate expired | not_major | — |

Recurring series `kronos-certificate-rotation` (INC-2025-006, INC-2025-012): individually not major, combined **major** (clients, duration).
